verified stepwise on the unchanged source fixture; native gate at before and tip; dagger skip verified in Lunal mode and the skip suppressed in the runtime munchkin mode by a dedicated fixture mode. Mode attribution: config-flag gate was inert for Warrior/Druid/Ranger (class flag) and is superseded; the runtime-mode gate keeps the Lua path for every class and is inactive only in munchkin mode. Consumer profile supplemented with borg_munchkin_by_class=FALSE and the source kit's broken profile blob replaced; carried/open+patch-active after merge

correction.reason: the unrestricted skip made every marked-bad item a non-target in munchkin mode too, where the borg deliberately collects what it can sell; the take flow then returned false and the borg oscillated climb/dive at shallow depth
correction.change: skip only outside the runtime munchkin mode (borg.munchkin_mode false); an earlier attempt gated on borg_cfg[BORG_MUNCHKIN_START], which is a class/config flag forced true for Warrior/Druid/Ranger and therefore disabled the fix for those classes everywhere, including the Lunal path
correction.evidence: the kit now runs the same marked-bad Dagger with munchkin mode off (skipped) and on (taken): the config-flag gate fails the munchkin mode, the runtime gate passes it
correction.cohort: the Warrior cohort is in munchkin mode by class and never enters Lunal mode (BORG_SELF_LUNAL plus preparation 15 deeper), so it cannot measure the Lunal path; it is recorded as not exercised, not as neutral
